items.title: Learning to play Minecraft with Video PreTraining
items.summary: We trained a neural network to play Minecraft by Video PreTraining (VPT) on a massive unlabeled video dataset of human Minecraft play, while using only a small amount of labeled contractor data. With fine-tuning, our model can learn to craft diamond tools, a task that usually takes proficient humans over 20 minutes (24,000 actions). items.summaryZh: OpenAI研究团队通过视频预Training（VPT）技术，利用海量无标签人类游戏视频和一个小规模带标签的专家动作数据集，成功训练出一个能够玩Minecraft的神经网络模型。该模型能够使用键盘和鼠标等原生人类界面完成复杂的长周期任务（如制作钻石工具），这是迈向通用计算机操作智能体的重要突破。
